items.q: What's the minimum age for weed delivery in Ridgefield Park?
items.a_html: New Jersey's adult-use cannabis rules are clear: you must be 21 or older to place a delivery order. Age verification happens at account setup, and your driver will confirm your ID at the door before handing over your order. There are no exceptions to this requirement.

items.q: What kind of ID do I need for a Lady L delivery order?
items.a_html: Any valid, government-issued photo ID will work. That includes driver's licenses, state-issued IDs, and passports. Out-of-state IDs are welcome. Your ID must be uploaded to your Lady L account before your first order, and you'll need the physical ID on hand when your driver arrives.

items.q: Is a medical cannabis card required to place a delivery order?
items.a_html: Nope, no medical card needed. Lady L operates as an adult-use dispensary, which means any customer 21 or older can request delivery. A valid ID and a confirmed Lady L account are all that's required to get started.

items.q: How much cannabis can be included in a single delivery?
items.a_html:
New Jersey law allows us to sell up to the equivalent of 28.35 grams, or one ounce, of usable cannabis per transaction. That can be made up of any combination of the following:

  • Dried Flower/Bud: 28.35 grams (1 ounce).
  • Concentrates/Resin/Oils: 4 grams (solid or liquid/vaporized oil).
  • Ingestible Items (Gummies/Edibles): 1,000 mg of THC (roughly ten 100mg packages).
  • Maximum Possession Limit: Up to 6 ounces of cannabis and cannabis products.
  • Mixing Products: You can mix and match, for example, by purchasing 1/2 ounce of flower and 2 grams of concentrates.
  • Daily Limits: The 1-ounce limit is generally considered a daily limit across all dispensaries.

items.q: What taxes apply to cannabis delivery orders in New Jersey?
items.a_html: Adult-use cannabis purchases in New Jersey carry a 6.625% state sales tax, a 2% municipal transfer or user tax where applicable, and a $2.50 per ounce Social Equity Excise Fee (SEEF). These taxes apply to delivery orders just as they do to in-store purchases, and all applicable charges are shown at checkout before you confirm.
